try:
    process_order(msg.value())
    consumer.commit(msg)
except Exception as e:
    producer.produce("orders-dlq", key=msg.key(),
                      value=msg.value(), headers={"error": str(e)})
    producer.flush()
    consumer.commit(msg)
caption: A poison-pill message goes to orders-dlq instead of blocking every event behind it on this partition.
